proof.cut_plane_derivation: A planar cut x=a+by+cz tangent to the two end disks at B0=(0,0,-4) and T6=(6,0,4) gives a=3,c=3/4. Since the complete section lies within 0<=x<=6 and touches its extreme at y=0,z=+-4, a nonzero b would exceed an end near one tangency (disk support radius4*sqrt(b^2+c^2)>3). Thus b=0; the frozen sampled cut independently satisfies x=3+3z/4. This uses true tangencies and a complete untruncated planar section, never ellipse pixel lengths.
